thread.title: What Analysts Expect for Ford’s Q2 2018 Earnings

title: What Analysts Expect for Ford’s Q2 2018 Earnings
text: What Analysts Expect for Ford’s Q2 2018 Earnings More While Ford (F) stock underperformed the S&P 500 in Q2 2018, General Motors (GM), Tesla (TSLA), and Ferrari (RACE) outperformed broader markets. Ford faced negative sentiment due to trade concerns. On the brighter side, growth in Q2 US light vehicle sales boosted investor confidence and prevented auto stocks falling significantly.
